basic_info.description: We're back after street construction! Fresh, contemporary pied-a-terre in Nob Hill's luxury Montaire, a boutique building superbly located in SF's classic neighborhood. Generous 1BR, 1BA south-facing condominium served by 24/7 front desk staff, building elevator. Includes entry foyer, living room with wood-burning fireplace & window seat, dining area & galley-style updated kitchen. Black granite countertops, Subzero refrigerator, Bosch gas cooktop, dual ovens, dishwasher & atmospheric under-counter lighting are highlights of this well-equipped kitchen. The BR suite offers south-facing window seat, new carpet, large walk-in closet, marble bath with shower, jetted tub, dual sinks & private WC. Custom lighting, radiant heat, refinished wood floors in the principal rooms, washer/dryer & storage in the hall closet add to the appeal of this residence. Deeded garage parking & adjacent large storage room are on same level as #302. Experience SF's renowned beautiful Nob Hill with Grace Cathedral, Huntington Park & fabulous restaurants nearby, yet enjoy the privacy of a luxury building of only 20 units. Location is walkable & close to public transit. For those accustomed to fine living, the Montaire is an oasis of calm. SFO is under 20 minutes by car. Truly a perfect pied-a-terre.
